Name: Pack and Backpack Collection
Author: SilentResident
Description:
[b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]𖤣[b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]‧[/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]⁺[/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]𖥧[/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]˖[/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]𓏲[/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]. [/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]INFO .[/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]˖[/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]𖡼.⚘[/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]˚[/size][/font][/u][/b]
This mod adds 10 new and unique packs, satchels, bags, and backpacks to [i]Stardew Valley[/i] in a lore-friendly way, while carefully avoiding any changes to the two default packs already in the game. This brings the total number of available packs for the player to purchase at Pierre's General Store from the original 2 to a whopping 12!

Each pack, satchel, bag, and backpack is distinct in appearance, and they all vary in cost and size. The goal of the mod is to respect what the game already offers in terms of inventory expansion, while also taking the concept to the next level
for players who want more options in their playthroughs.

Every item has been thoughtfully designed based on [i]Stardew Valley[/i]’s myths and lore, with the intent of giving each one its own charm and personality.

I created this mod because I was frustrated with the limited options available for inventory-expanding packs. Most existing mods simply offer recolored versions of the two original packs found in the game. Why should I spend a ridiculous amount
of hard-earned gold, only to receive from Pierre a pack or backpack that looks exactly like the one I already own, just in a different color?

I don’t want a recolored upgrade—I want a brand-new, unique item that justifies the higher price and expanded capacity.

Another reason I decided to create my own pack mod is that many other mods implement new packs in ways that often cause glitches or bugs. With this in mind, my mod strictly adheres to the “12-slots-per-row” rule that ConcernedApe set for [i]Stardew Valley[/i]. This eliminates potential issues that could occur if uneven slot rows were introduced, and it ensures that the inventory remains organized and consistent—even when switching between different-sized rows.


[b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]𖤣[b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]‧[/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]⁺[/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]𖥧[/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]˖[/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]𓏲[/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5].[/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5] DETAILS[/size][/font][/u][/b][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u] .˖𖡼.⚘˚[/u][/b][/size][/font]
All the new packs, satchels, bags and backpacks that are added by my mod, are marked with the label "NEW!" before them:
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/29382/29382-1731750276-1079655157.png[/img]

[b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]𖤣[b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]‧[/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]⁺[/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]𖥧[/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]˖[/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]𓏲[/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5].[/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u] FUNCTIONALITY .˖𖡼.⚘˚[/u][/b][/size][/font]
My mod merely adds new items (backpacks) to the game. It does not modify the UI's functionality to accommodate for these backpack upgrades!
Instead, it is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21588]The Return Of Custom Backpack Framework[/url] which does this task, along with other features required by my mod.

For this reason, the Framework is per-requisite for using my Pack Collection mod. With the Framework installed, adding more backpacks to the game not only is possible, but also allows for an enlarged inventory to be utilized just like any other forms of large storage.

Here an example screenshot of a upgraded inventory with the Backpack Framework installed:
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/29382/29382-1731789219-1064134952.png[/img]


[b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]𖤣[b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]‧[/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]⁺[/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]𖥧[/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]˖[/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]𓏲[/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5].[/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u] CONTROLS .˖𖡼.⚘˚[/u][/b][/size][/font]
Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21588]The Return Of Custom Backpack Framework[/url], you can control and navigate your upgraded inventory in a number of ways, which is useful when your inventory features more rows than it can display at a given time on-screen.

Here is an example screenshot showcasing the Backpack Framework's improvements to your inventory:
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/29382/29382-1731792069-480081316.png[/img]
(Note that my UI may look a tad different, probably because I have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/518]Chests Anywhere[/url] installed too)


[b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]𖤣[b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]‧[/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]⁺[/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]𖥧[/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]˖[/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]𓏲[/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5].[/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u] INSTALLATION .˖𖡼.⚘˚[/u][/b][/size][/font]
To install, just unzip/extract the archive's contents into the game's mod directory. (By default, is: [i]\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\[/i] )


[b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]𖤣[b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]‧[/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]⁺[/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]𖥧[/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]˖[/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]𓏲[/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5].[/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u] UNINSTALLATION .˖𖡼.⚘˚[/u][/b][/size][/font]
This mod is safe to uninstall mid-playthrough. However, certain steps are required before uninstalling it, to ensure that no harm is done to your existing save games:
First, install the following mod: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4]CJB Cheats Menu[/url] and then run the game (with Pack Collection still installed), and load your save game. Remove all the items from your inventory and then use the CJB Cheats Menu to reset your inventory size to vanilla levels (12 slots if no backpack upgrades were purchased at Pierre's Store, or 24 slots if you already bought your Large Pack, or 36 if you bought Deluxe Pack), and then save your game and quit. Then, navigate to the game's mod directory, (by default: \Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\ ) and delete the Pack Collection mod's folder.


[b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]𖤣[b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]‧[/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]⁺[/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]𖥧[/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]˖[/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]𓏲[/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]. [/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]CUSTOMIZATION .˖𖡼.⚘˚[/size][/font][/u][/b]
Just open the mod's content.json file (located in [i]\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\PackCollection\[/i] ) with your favorite text editor and adjust the packs to your liking. These are mostly self-explanatory:

[size=2][quote]"[i]name": "Large Pack"[/i][/quote][/size]sets the item's name that is shown in-game, i.e. Large Pack.

[i][size=2][quote]"cost": 2000,[/quote][/size][/i]sets the price (in gold), i.e. 2,000g.

[size=2][i][quote]"24"[/quote][/i][/size]sets the amount of slots, i.e. 24 inventory slots (2 rows of 12 slots each) Make sure to use numbers divided by 12 (i.e. 12, 24, 36, 72, 252, and so on) as this eliminates any possible bugs in-game and the potential disorganization/displacement of your inventory items that could be caused by switching inventory rows that are uneven in size (any number that cannot be divided by 12).

If you seek to remove/disable a pack/satchel/bag/backpack, from your game, simply delete the whole portion for that item, starting from the line containing the slot amount and stretching down to the line containing the }, as shown here in this example:
[i][quote] [size=2] "24": {
  "name": "Large Pack",
  "cost": 2000,
  "texturePath": "platinummyr.CPMoreBackpacks/backpacks",
  "textureRect":
  {
"X":0,
"Y":0,
"Width": 12,
"Height":14
  }
},[/size][/quote][/i]Deleting this and then saving the file, removes the pack alltogether from Pierre's General Store, without affecting the other packs available for sale. Pierre will simply sell the next upgrade in the list, provided that there are still more in that list for him to sell.

If, for whatever reason, you regret buying any of these upgrades and want to remove inventory slots mid-game, simply use a mod such as the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4]CJB Cheats Menu[/url]﻿. However, it is strongly recommended that you backup your save files first!


[b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]𖤣[b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]‧[/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]⁺[/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]𖥧[/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]˖[/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]𓏲[/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5].[/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u] MULTIPLAYER .˖𖡼.⚘˚[/u][/b][/size][/font]
My mod relies on the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21588]The Return Of Custom Backpack Framework[/url] for adding custom backpacks/satchels/bags/packs to the game. However  I do not know if the Framework supports Multiplayer.. If you have the Backpack Framework installed, but no new backpacks show up in
your Multiplayer, then it is recommend that you inform the author of the
Framework [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21588?tab=bugs]here[/url] so that they can look into it and hopefully fix it.


[b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]𖤣[b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]‧[/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]⁺[/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]𖥧[/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]˖[/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]𓏲[/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]. [/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]PERMISSIONS .˖𖡼.⚘˚[/size][/font][/u][/b]
Everybody is welcome to update and re-upload my mod in the event it gets outdated or breaks with a future update patch and I am not actively around to maintain/update it. Also everybody is welcome to use any of my assets for their mods. In any case, just give me a credit where due.


[b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]𖤣[b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]‧[/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]⁺[/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]𖥧[/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]˖[/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]𓏲[/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5].[/size][/font][/u][/b][/size][/font][/u][/b][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][u] CREDITS .˖𖡼.⚘˚[/u][/b][/size][/font]
